pr checks.--web: Opens an external browser rather than rendering checks. The harness deliberately sets GH_BROWSER/BROWSER=false; browser navigation cannot be verified by this noninteractive CLI sweep.

pr comment.--web: Opens a browser comment form requiring browser interaction. The harness disables browser launching; body/file and comment mutation paths are tested directly.

pr create.--web: Hands creation to a browser form and does not submit a pull request through gh. Browser launching is deliberately disabled by the harness.

pr diff.--web: Opens the web diff in a browser; the harness disables browser launching. Diff, patch, and filename responses are asserted via the CLI instead.

pr list.--web: Opens the pull request listing in an external browser, which the noninteractive harness deliberately disables.

pr view.--web: Opens the pull request page in an external browser, which the noninteractive harness deliberately disables.
